<thought>Based on the molecular formula (C9H7O4), DBE = 6, presence of an aromatic ring (6 aromatic carbons), two carbonyl groups, and one methyl group, the structure matches acetyl‑salicylic acid (aspirin). The molecule can be conceptually split into an acetyl fragment and a benzoic‑acid fragment that are joined through an ester linkage. The SMILES strings for these two joinable fragments are:

1. Acetyl fragment (acetyl‑oxy): CC(=O)O  
2. Benzoic‑acid fragment (aryl‑carboxylic acid): c1ccccc1C(=O)O

These fragments can be connected via the oxygen atom to give the full SMILES CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1C(=O)O.>

<final_answer>['CC(=O)O', 'c1ccccc1C(=O)O']</final_answer>
